We need to produce correct XML tags. Let's do:

<thought>We need to apply template 84231 to each of the three product SMILES to get precursors.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO", "template_id": "84231"}</action_input>

Then repeat for other two.
